frontier_act_119.text: We need a balanced approach to AI with common sense guardrails and a uniform national standard that protects Americans while allowing innovation to grow and ensuring the United States stays ahead of China. The bipartisan FRONTIER Act, which has drawn support from stakeholders including OpenAI, takes an important step toward that goal by establishing greater transparency, oversight and accountability for the most advanced AI systems. As this technology continues to rapidly develop, Congress must ensure we have the appropriate safeguards in place to protect consumers, our privacy and national security while giving American companies the certainty they need to continue innovating and competing on the world stage,”

deepseek.reason: The speaker calls the bipartisan FRONTIER Act an important step and cites its transparency and oversight provisions.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement names the FRONTIER Act and explicitly endorses it.

china_race_dynamics.text: We need to listen to industry leaders and experts who are sounding the alarm about the dangers and risks of Artificial Intelligence and develop a balanced and thoughtful approach. While we need to stay ahead of the curve and not fall behind China, we must also have safeguards in place to protect privacy, communities, the environment, our national security and humanity. In my opinion, this would include national standards, federal licensing, consumer protections and mandatory incident reporting and response protocols to be in a position to intercept bad actors using AI for malice.
